coverage.title: Programmatic focus and same-target no-op
coverage.verified: Blur precedes Focus, related targets are exact, notifications are noncancelable with no fabricated input; same-owner operations emit no events.

coverage.title: Physical keyboard repeat and modifiers
coverage.verified: First down false, 26 subsequent down repeats true, Up false; Shift survives input translation and refocus restarts repeat.

coverage.title: Cancelled first Space and mandatory release cleanup
coverage.verified: Prevented first down and every repeat stay unarmed. Following accepted hold stays armed; prevented Up always clears Space.

coverage.title: Queued Focus and KeyDown redirects; stale target
coverage.verified: Focus(A) redirects to B and reports original request false; r redirects B to A; destroyed target request d reports stale handle without taking focus.

coverage.title: Two-view native focus and isolation
coverage.verified: Native focus transfers to view2; its keys route to B with fresh repeat. Clearing view1 does not steal view2 native focus.
coverage.limits: The control click emits PointerCancel at V1:311, which clears held Space before V1:312 FocusLost. This is not native proof of FocusLost cleaning an armed Space latch.

coverage.title: Host text input keeps native focus across unrelated clear
coverage.verified: Exact host change records show host123 followed by host123more across V2 ClearFocus; logical focus stays empty and scene operation counts remain unchanged throughout each typing span.

coverage.title: Native window focus loss and recovery
coverage.verified: Alt-Tab/window change reported by operator; routed FocusLost clears logical owner, repeated loss is inert, refocus and new key recover.
coverage.limits: No armed capture or Space was active at this physical FocusLost.

coverage.title: Release outside uses existing cancellation contract
coverage.verified: Active pan moves viewport, native outside mouse release yields PointerCancel, clears capture/Space/editing and restores baseline pan; no Click is emitted.
coverage.limits: SceneView render.rs on_mouse_up_out intentionally routes PointerCancel, not PointerUp. This preserves the existing adapter behavior.

coverage.title: Inside click and inside pan release
coverage.verified: Ordinary inside release emits PointerUp then Click. Inside pan PointerUp releases capture and retains final pan; prevented Space Up clears only the Space latch.

coverage.title: Escape
coverage.verified: Physical Escape Down/Up observed with no active capture.
coverage.limits: Active-pan Escape cleanup is covered by existing pure tests, not by this native session.

recommendation.EVT-01: Accept the existing bounded tree-routing/default-action contract: existing capture/target/bubble, once/off, queue and prevention tests plus exact native/pure input replay. Native outside release deliberately cancels; this is not browser event parity.
recommendation.EVT-02: Accept the existing keyboard/programmatic-focus contract: physical programmatic focus matrix, key repeat/Space, redirects/stale targets, native focus loss and instance isolation, backed by focused lifetime and active-cleanup pure tests.
